text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping after training, 
Epiphaneia suddenly took off running, just 
like always.
choice_data_list: (I finally caught up...)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone, everyone—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it was you! The one who was 
calling for me!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? W-Well, I guess you could say that, 
but at the same time you couldn't reall—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's spin it!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia enthusiastically grabbed the 
raffle wheel's handle!
choice_data_list: Wait, the raffle tickets!!!!
Wait, the raffle tickets!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion! Trainer, got a 
minute?
choice_data_list: I've still got a trick up my sleeve!
I've got one.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you!! Alright, let's go!!
choice_data_list: Go easy on the power, alright...!!
Go easy on the power, okay...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia turned the raffle wheel's 
handle, in what she considered a reserved 
manner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrrroom!!)
choice_data_list: (Please! Hold together, raffle wheel...!)

(Please! Hang in there, raffle 
machine...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "A natural result! Because I'm—"
choice_data_list: Destiny's on your side, after all.
Destiny really loves you, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Well then, let's head out right 
away!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A hot spring trip! Time to relax--!!
choice_data_list:
H-Hold on! I feel like something's still 
not right!

W-Wait! I feel like something's still not 
right!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what're you sayin'! The voice of 
destiny tooâ

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...!! Over hereee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Worker A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, who!? Um, we're currently drilling 
for a hot spring right now—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me, I can tell! —Dig right 
there!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on, right now, right this second!!!!

text_block_list.name: Worker A
text_block_list.text: H-Hahaha, yes!! Everyone! Let's dig!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The worker applied the drill to the exact 
spot Epiphaneia pointed out. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pshhhhhh!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: HOT SPRINGS--!!
choice_data_list: A hot spring...!?

text_block_list.name: Worker B
text_block_list.text:
"—Whew, you were a huge help! Excavation 
was proving quite difficult, you see... 
Once the construction is finished, please 
come take a dip!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll do that! Man, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To enjoy the newly opened hot spring, the 
trip itself was postponed. ...Somehow, I 
felt a sense of relief.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see! Fate just wanted to treat me to a 
hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In that case— let's enjoy it to the 
fullest!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, four equal slices, so... All 
right, right here! Cutting time!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! You're so good at 
cutting...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Right! Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Cesario, Kris S, Trainer! Let's eat 
together!
choice_data_list: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But—are you sure? This is... your hamburg 
steak.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Of course, I'd love to! Because—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Eating together with everyone I love is 
the greatest blessing of all!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There's so much here! It feels like no 
matter how much we eat, we'll never finish 
it all!
choice_data_list: So... what do we do?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's decided!! Joy is meant to be shared 
by all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you there! —Your cheeks look like 
carrots, how cute!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Which makes this super-nutritious carrot 
perfect for you! Please, eat it!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not really sure what's going on, 
but... thank you for the food...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You over there too! Yeah, you with the 
carrot ribbon!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
There's plenty, so take as much as you 
want! You'll definitely love it! The voice 
of destiny says so, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrots were handed out one after another 
to the girls Epiphaneia felt "carrots" 
from... It was a scene that felt both 
familiar and yet slightly different from 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see, just one bottle!
choice_data_list: That's a bit of a shame.
That's a bit of a shame, huh?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, this is the outcome fate guided us to! 
There must be a meaning behind it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Why just one? One... One... ...One.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh, got it! Understood!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It means you should savor your "number 
one" pick in your "number one" spot!
choice_data_list: (Sounds like a bad pun... oh well.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia munched happily on a carrot. I 
was once again reminded of her incredible 
ability to put a positive spin on 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: A losing ticket...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...No, that can't be! There must be a 
reason for this too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: For instance... that's it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna catch a cold after this, so 
that's why I won tissues!
choice_data_list: Are you gonna... catch a cold?
Are you going to... catch a cold?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to fully comprehend the blessing of 
tissues, Epiphaneia was left feeling 
puzzled...
